sources.title: nvidia/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Surg-CholecT50 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Overview Description: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Surg-CholecT50 is a multimodal large language model fine-tuned on the CholecT50 dataset of laparoscopic cholecystectomy procedures to recognize and describe surgical actions, instruments, and targets in endoscopic video frames.

sources.title: ResNet50 - PyTorch
sources.snippet: The ResNet50 v1.5 model is a modified version of the original ResNet50 v1 model. The difference between v1 and v1.5 is that, in the bottleneck blocks which requires downsampling, v1 has stride = 2 in the first 1×1 convolution, whereas v1.5 has stride = 2 in the 3×3 convolution.
